items.title: Campaign Sending
items.note: Section 19 audit covered MedStation groups on all four boards. payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • Context. On 11 September in the MedStation GoHighLevel group Renata said the latest campaigns never went to Weston, because the blasts run out of Kommo and Weston has moved off it. Ana Caroline confirmed the sends happen weekly off the monthly campaign artwork and that GoHighLevel can do the same. Mateus asked us to make it work there and said his own team should run it with support from Sohib's team, since they control Kommo themselves today and do not want to depend on third parties. Jonatan agreed to map the process. Rafaela covers the other units on Kommo; Weston has no owner yet.
  • Deliverable one, build the send path. Bulk send to a filtered Weston audience from the monthly creative, with a record of who received what.
  • Deliverable two, confirm what the account can actually send. Weston messaging runs through the WhatsApp 24 hour window, so a blast to a cold base is not the same as replying inside a session. State which channel each campaign type uses and what template approval it needs.
  • Deliverable three, hand it over. Run one supervised send with Rafaela and give her a written procedure.
  • Constraint. Reactivation loading starts Monday and that import must fire nothing. Do not run a campaign send into the same base until the import is finished and its suppression lifted.

Chase him, then either leave the sync off or re-enable it routing re-opened matters to the stage he confirms.

She thinks it is because she raised the opportunity on the contact record that already existed. Reproduce it and say whether a second matter on one contact is supported at all.

items.sourceLabel: WhatsApp: Maadi Law, 9/17 + WhatsApp: GHL Dev, 9/17

payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • Context. Maadi Law sends an automated acknowledgement when a lead arrives, then chases it about three hours later if the thread still looks unanswered. On 17 September the firm posted a screenshot of that chase firing again and asked why it is still happening. Their own side gave the answer: the lead had come through the IVR and spoken to the firm, but because no typed reply existed the system counted the thread as unanswered and sent the chase anyway.
  • The defect. Nacer put it plainly in the dev chat the same afternoon. The Automated Lead Follow-Up workflow does not truthfully check whether the contact has replied, or whether a call was had with the firm, before it continues. Only a typed reply stops it, so every phone conversation still looks like silence.
  • Deliverable one, add the call check. An inbound or answered call on the contact, IVR included, must stop the follow up exactly the way a reply does. Nacer has already told the firm this check is going in.
  • Deliverable two, fix the reply check. State what the workflow actually tests for a reply today, correct it, then take a dummy contact down each path, reply only and call only, and confirm the chase stops in both.
  • Deliverable three, clear the queue. Say how many contacts are enrolled and waiting on this reminder right now, and drop the ones who have already spoken to the firm.
  • Constraint. Keep this separate from the agreement signature cadence on Document Automation 12810218373. Different workflow, different stop condition.

@Ahmed Memon @Ali Shaheer

GoHighLevel intake and Clio Manage run in parallel until this is fixed.
  • This changes deliverable four above. The matching rule cannot key on email alone, because email matching is what collapsed these two records. Review the GoHighLevel contact configuration for whether two contacts can hold the same email address as separate records, and scope the inbound matching rule on phone and name instead.
  • Test before applying. Nacer asked for this explicitly. Prove on a test pair that separating two shared email contacts returns each record's own notes and opportunities with nothing lost, then apply.
  • Constraint: hold the quantify and merge steps on this item for any shared email set until that configuration answer is known, so merging does not destroy the records this problem just exposed.
